section.catchline: Disposition of certain taxes collected on Navajo Nation land located in Utah.
section.subsection: Except as provided in Subsection (2), there shall be deposited into the Navajo Revitalization Fund created in Section 63N-24-703 for taxes imposed under this part beginning on July 1, 1997:33% of the taxes collected on oil, gas, or other hydrocarbon substances produced from a well:for which production began on or before June 30, 1996; andattributable to interests in Utah held in trust by the United States for the Navajo Nation and the Navajo Nation's members; and80% of the taxes collected on oil, gas, or other hydrocarbon substances produced from a well:for which production began on or after July 1, 1996; andattributable to interests in Utah held in trust by the United States for the Navajo Nation and the Navajo Nation's members.

subsection.subsection: The maximum amount deposited in the Navajo Revitalization Fund may not exceed:$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2006-07; and$3,000,000 for fiscal years beginning with fiscal year 2007-08.
Any amounts in excess of the maximum described in Subsection (2)(a) shall be credited as provided in Sections 51-9-305, 51-9-306, 51-9-1202, and 59-5-115.
